verdict.rationale: E2B provides official SDKs (JS/Python) with documented Sandbox.create(), file I/O, command execution, and a companion Desktop SDK and CLI, all backed by first-party docs and probes confirming live documentation. Community evidence corroborates real usage (Python vs TypeScript parity noted). Missing for 10: independent hands-on SDK reliability corroboration beyond one HN thread, and no OpenAPI/spec reference confirming full API surface coverage.
